name: sol-advisor
description: Token-efficient capability router: Terra / Medium controls by default, planning escalates Terra High then Sol Low/Medium, implementation stays cheap-first, and verification scales from Terra to Sol only when complexity or risk warrants it.

interface.shortDescription: Default to Terra, delegate cheaply, and escalate planning or verification only when needed.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor uses GPT-5.6 Terra / Medium as the normal primary controller. Planning escalates through Terra / High, Sol / Low, and Sol / Medium only when justified. Implementation prefers Luna / Low or Medium, then Terra / Medium, reserving Sol / High for genuinely hard execution. Verification starts in Terra and scales through Sol / Low, Medium, or High according to complexity, risk, and residual uncertainty.
defaultPrompt: Use Sol Advisor with Terra / Medium as the default controller and route work through the lowest capable lane.
Plan upward only as needed: Terra High, then Sol Low, then Sol Medium; do not use Sol High for planning.
Verify with Terra first, then Sol Low/Medium/High only when complexity or risk justifies the upgrade.
